Page 1 RS02C...17 row assigns 2.5 W at 25 °C to characteristic U, whose column applies to tolerances ±0.05% through ±5%; 1% falls in U. The 3.25 W characteristic V column applies to ±3% through ±10%, not this F variant. This column tolerance range is not a resistance stability guarantee. Page 3 performance-test ΔR limits and derating curves are separate; do not invent a derated power or conflate those tests with nominal tolerance.
